description: A ground-level photograph depicting an extensive wetland environment, likely a freshwater or brackish marsh. The landscape features large areas of shallow standing water reflecting an overcast sky, interspersed with dense patches of tall, dry, straw-coloured reeds and grasses. Some smaller areas of greener vegetation are visible within the water. A muddy, vegetated bank is visible in the immediate foreground, leading into the water. A distant treeline stretches across the horizon under the cloudy sky. This image illustrates a typical reed-covered wetland or an area of non-grazed/mowed wetland dominated by tall grasses and sedges, consistent with CLMS (Copernicus Land Monitoring Service) land cover categories for wetlands.
